mathematical_meanings: Left image: The shading highlights the angle between the downward reference direction and OA. Right image: The shading designates the entire area of the diamond-shaped quadrilateral.
Rationales: The feature highlights the angle between two rays in the left image and selects a geometric area in the right image. The cyan wedge next to 32° at O. The blue interior of the diamond divided by two magenta diagonals.
